dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli along the mid-lateral axis featuring high-contrast dark outer perimeters that transition sharply to lighter-toned interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid low-intensity dark clusters lacking internal gradients, interspersed between the larger macro-annuli across the dorsal and mid-lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest centrally located macro-annuli form a distinct scalene quadrilateral, with an adjacent triad of smaller blobs forming a tight acute triangle.
